why: with the eyes and spirit cast down
the fluid in the veins of the gods
the tree with hanging yellow chains
the plantago whose seeds look like fleas
a body of states and not a meaning
the blennius of the shore rocks
the growing together of two bones
the single cell that changes shape
the outer rim of a wheel
painting in wax fixed by heat
the one who tests the metal
the beast that carries its young in a pouch
the burnt remains of a fire
the fish that fastens to a larger one
